editorial.blurb: A beloved no-frills diner that nails classic comfort food with generous portions and genuine warmth, earning its reputation as a true hidden gem.
editorial.insiderTip: Come late-night (they're open at 3:30am) for a cozy escape, and order the sausage patties—reviewers rave about how perfectly they're cooked. Ask your server for recommendations like Chunky, who takes time to make you feel at home.
